stages.title: Extract atomic claims
notes: Stored-only replay can be used for deterministic regression without provider calls.

stages.title: Certify dashboard bilingual presentation and exports
Filter historical DeepSeek generations
notes: Optional compatibility stage; not a required edge in the golden path.

stages.title: Register verified trained models in MLflow and publish receipt
notes: The stage is idempotent by tracking key but not pure because it mutates MLflow registry state.
Champion promotion is deliberately excluded from this stage.
Phase 5 remains the owner of the canonical immutable MLflow receipt; Phase 6 verifies and links that existing artifact without repackaging it.

stages.title: Promote a governed MLflow candidate to champion
notes: External MLflow mutation is recorded by a durable promotion decision and can enter FAILED_PARTIAL.

stages.title: Run deterministic Prefect orchestration acceptance fixture
notes: Used only by isolated Phase 6 live acceptance; never part of scientific output.

stages.title: Run protected Prefect approval acceptance fixture
notes: Used only to prove suspend, resume, approval, and rejection semantics.

stages.title: Promote a governed research release
notes: Governed target approval is validated by the Phase 7 promotion policy engine.

stages.title: Build immutable complete release bundle index
notes: This stage indexes immutable parents and never promotes or mutates a release.
